body:
Reduce per-step fixed CPU overhead on the decode hot path (~50-140us/step): gate cpu_timer's record_function on profiler activity, pool CUDA timing events and reuse a persistent sample_end_evt, replace the O(num_reqs) SO status scan with a scheduler-side num_active_so count, and fast-path empty request-output collections
